opportunities.name: Account brief email from SEC 10-K and Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, find the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, get HQ, employees and CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an account-brief email to a recipient.
steps: Search the ticker in SEC EDGAR company search and select the company
Open Form filter and the 10-K Annual report; note the filing date
Search the company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count and CEO from the infobox
Open mail compose, enter To address
Enter subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Enter body summarizing HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date
Discard/send the draft

opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison: currency conversion and local time email
opportunities.description: Convert two quote amounts in two currencies to USD on Xe, look up the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email the comparison to procurement.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount A, set from-currency, set to USD, Convert
Enter amount B, set other currency, to USD, Convert
Compare USD results to determine the cheaper option
Search supplier city on timeanddate World Clock and read local time
Compose mail to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Body lists both conversions, cheaper currency, and supplier local time
Discard/send

opportunities.name: Time zone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month/country, find the time difference on the timeanddate converter and holidays to avoid, then email ops a sync note.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city 1 and city 2
Read the time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, choose the country
Identify holiday dates in the target month
Compose mail to ops with subject 'Sync: <City1> / <City2>, <Month>'
Body states hours ahead and dates to avoid
Discard/send
